questions.q: He is ___ honest man.
questions.e: 'honest'માં h બોલાતો નથી, શરૂઆત સ્વર અવાજ (ઓ)થી થાય છે, તેથી 'an'.
questions.qe: He is ___ honest man.
questions.ee: The h in 'honest' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound (o): 'an'.

questions.q: She is ___ European.
questions.e: 'European' 'યુ' અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે (વ્યંજન અવાજ), તેથી 'a'.
questions.qe: She is ___ European.
questions.ee: 'European' starts with a 'yu' sound (a consonant sound), so 'a'.

questions.q: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.e: જગતમાં એક જ હોય તેવી વસ્તુઓ (sun, moon, earth) પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.ee: 'The' goes before things that are one of a kind (sun, moon, earth).

questions.q: He is ___ MLA.
questions.e: 'MLA'નો ઉચ્ચાર 'એમ-એલ-એ' સ્વર અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે, તેથી 'an'.
questions.qe: He is ___ MLA.
questions.ee: 'MLA' is said 'em-el-ay', starting with a vowel sound, so 'an'.

questions.q: I met ___ one-eyed man.
questions.e: 'one' 'વન' (w અવાજ)થી બોલાય છે, તેથી 'a'.
questions.qe: I met ___ one-eyed man.
questions.ee: 'One' is said 'wun' (a w sound), so 'a'.

questions.q: ___ Ganga is a holy river.
questions.e: નદીઓ, સમુદ્રો અને પર્વતમાળાઓનાં નામ પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: ___ Ganga is a holy river.
questions.ee: 'The' goes before names of rivers, seas and mountain ranges.

questions.q: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.e: 'engineer' સ્વર અવાજ (એ)થી શરૂ થાય છે, તેથી 'an'.
questions.qe: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.ee: 'Engineer' starts with a vowel sound (e), so 'an'.

questions.q: Gujarat University is ___ university in Ahmedabad.
questions.e: 'university' 'યુ' અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે, તેથી 'a'.
questions.qe: Gujarat University is ___ university in Ahmedabad.
questions.ee: 'University' starts with a 'yu' sound, so 'a'.

questions.q: ___ Taj Mahal is in Agra.
questions.e: પ્રખ્યાત ઇમારતોનાં નામ પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: ___ Taj Mahal is in Agra.
questions.ee: 'The' goes before the names of famous buildings.

questions.q: Gold is ___ precious metal.
questions.e: 'precious' વ્યંજન અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે અને એકવચન ગણી શકાય તેવી સંજ્ઞા છે, તેથી 'a'.
questions.qe: Gold is ___ precious metal.
questions.ee: 'Precious' starts with a consonant sound and 'metal' is a singular countable noun here, so 'a'.

questions.q: She plays ___ violin beautifully.
questions.e: સંગીતનાં વાદ્યો (violin, flute, piano) વગાડવાની વાત હોય ત્યારે તેમની પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: She plays ___ violin beautifully.
questions.ee: When we talk of playing an instrument (violin, flute, piano), 'the' comes before it.

questions.q: What ___ beautiful flower this is!
questions.e: 'What' વાળા ઉદ્ગારવાચક વાક્યમાં એકવચન ગણી શકાય તેવી સંજ્ઞા પહેલાં 'a/an' વપરાય; 'beautiful' વ્યંજન અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે.
questions.qe: What ___ beautiful flower this is!
questions.ee: In 'What' exclamations, 'a/an' comes before a singular countable noun; 'beautiful' starts with a consonant sound.

questions.q: He goes to ___ church every Sunday to pray.
questions.e: church, school, temple જેવી જગ્યાએ તેના મૂળ હેતુ (પ્રાર્થના, અભ્યાસ) માટે જઈએ ત્યારે article વપરાતો નથી.
questions.qe: He goes to ___ church every Sunday to pray.
questions.ee: No article when we go to a church, school or temple for its main purpose (prayer, study).

questions.q: He earns fifty rupees ___ hour.
questions.e: 'hour'માં h મૂક છે અને શરૂઆત સ્વર અવાજ (અવર)થી થાય છે, તેથી 'an'; અહીં 'an hour' એટલે 'પ્રતિ કલાક'.
questions.qe: He earns fifty rupees ___ hour.
questions.ee: The h in 'hour' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound: 'an hour', meaning 'per hour'.

questions.q: This is ___ best book I have ever read.
questions.e: Superlative degree (best, tallest) પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: This is ___ best book I have ever read.
questions.ee: 'The' goes before a superlative (best, tallest).

questions.q: We had ___ heavy breakfast this morning.
questions.e: ભોજનનાં નામ (breakfast, lunch) પહેલાં સામાન્ય રીતે article ન આવે, પણ તેની પહેલાં વિશેષણ (heavy) હોય તો 'a' વપરાય.
questions.qe: We had ___ heavy breakfast this morning.
questions.ee: Meals (breakfast, lunch) usually take no article, but with an adjective before them (heavy) we use 'a'.

questions.q: She speaks ___ English fluently.
questions.e: ભાષાનાં નામ પહેલાં article વપરાતો નથી; પણ 'the English language'માં 'the' આવે.
questions.qe: She speaks ___ English fluently.
questions.ee: No article before the name of a language; but 'the English language' takes 'the'.

questions.q: The doctor asked for ___ X-ray of his leg.
questions.e: 'X'નો ઉચ્ચાર 'એક્સ' સ્વર અવાજથી શરૂ થાય છે, તેથી 'an X-ray'.
questions.qe: The doctor asked for ___ X-ray of his leg.
questions.ee: 'X' is said 'ex', starting with a vowel sound, so 'an X-ray'.

questions.q: Kalidas is called ___ Shakespeare of India.
questions.e: કોઈ વ્યક્તિને બીજી પ્રખ્યાત વ્યક્તિ સાથે સરખાવીએ ત્યારે નામ પહેલાં 'the' વપરાય.
questions.qe: Kalidas is called ___ Shakespeare of India.
questions.ee: When comparing someone to another famous person, 'the' goes before the name.

questions.q: Children love to play ___ cricket.
questions.e: રમતોનાં નામ (cricket, football, chess) પહેલાં article વપરાતો નથી.
questions.qe: Children love to play ___ cricket.
questions.ee: No article before the names of games (cricket, football, chess).

questions.q: She was born ___ 1995.
questions.e: વર્ષ, મહિના અને ઋતુ પહેલાં 'in' વપરાય; ચોક્કસ તારીખ/વાર પહેલાં 'on'.
questions.qe: She was born ___ 1995.
questions.ee: 'In' goes before years, months and seasons; 'on' before a particular date or day.

questions.q: The train arrives ___ 6 o'clock.
questions.e: ઘડિયાળના ચોક્કસ સમય પહેલાં 'at' વપરાય (at 6 o'clock, at noon).
questions.qe: The train arrives ___ 6 o'clock.
questions.ee: 'At' goes before an exact clock time (at 6 o'clock, at noon).

questions.q: I will meet you ___ Monday.
questions.e: વાર અને તારીખ પહેલાં 'on' વપરાય (on Monday, on 26th January).
questions.qe: I will meet you ___ Monday.
questions.ee: 'On' goes before days and dates (on Monday, on 26th January).

questions.q: He has been ill ___ last Monday.
questions.e: સમયનું શરૂઆતનું બિંદુ (last Monday, 2010) બતાવવા Perfect tense સાથે 'since' વપરાય.
questions.qe: He has been ill ___ last Monday.
questions.ee: 'Since' shows the starting point of time (last Monday, 2010) with a perfect tense.

questions.q: She has been waiting ___ two hours.
questions.e: સમયનો ગાળો (two hours, five years) બતાવવા 'for' વપરાય.
questions.qe: She has been waiting ___ two hours.
questions.ee: 'For' shows a period of time (two hours, five years).

questions.q: He travelled to Surat ___ bus.
questions.e: વાહનવ્યવહારના સાધન પહેલાં article વગર 'by' વપરાય (by bus, by train).
questions.qe: He travelled to Surat ___ bus.
questions.ee: 'By' goes before a means of transport, with no article (by bus, by train).

questions.q: The sun sets ___ the west.
questions.e: દિશા બતાવતી વખતે 'in the east/west' વપરાય.
questions.qe: The sun sets ___ the west.
questions.ee: For directions we say 'in the east/west'.

questions.q: Divide the mangoes ___ the two brothers.
questions.e: બે વ્યક્તિ/વસ્તુ વચ્ચે 'between' અને બેથી વધુ વચ્ચે 'among' વપરાય.
questions.qe: Divide the mangoes ___ the two brothers.
questions.ee: 'Between' is for two people or things, 'among' for more than two.

questions.q: He is fond ___ music.
questions.e: 'fond' સાથે હંમેશાં 'of' આવે: 'fond of' એટલે શોખીન.
questions.qe: He is fond ___ music.
questions.ee: 'Fond' always takes 'of': 'fond of' means liking something.

questions.q: Translate this sentence ___ Gujarati.
questions.e: એક ભાષામાંથી બીજી ભાષામાં અનુવાદ માટે 'translate into' વપરાય.
questions.qe: Translate this sentence ___ Gujarati.
questions.ee: Translating from one language to another uses 'translate into'.

questions.q: She is married ___ a doctor.
questions.e: 'married' સાથે 'to' વપરાય: 'married to', 'married with' ખોટું છે.
questions.qe: She is married ___ a doctor.
questions.ee: 'Married' takes 'to': 'married to'; 'married with' is wrong.

questions.q: He was accused ___ theft.
questions.e: 'accuse' સાથે 'of' વપરાય; જ્યારે 'charge' સાથે 'with' આવે (charged with theft).
questions.qe: He was accused ___ theft.
questions.ee: 'Accuse' takes 'of'; 'charge' takes 'with' (charged with theft).

questions.q: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
questions.e: 'prefer' સાથે સરખામણીમાં 'than' નહીં, 'to' વપરાય.
questions.qe: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
questions.ee: With 'prefer', the comparison uses 'to', not 'than'.

questions.q: He congratulated me ___ my success.
questions.e: 'congratulate someone on something' એ સાચો પ્રયોગ છે.
questions.qe: He congratulated me ___ my success.
questions.ee: The correct use is 'congratulate someone on something'.

questions.q: He is blind ___ one eye.
questions.e: શરીરના અંગની ખામી માટે 'blind in one eye', 'lame in one leg' વપરાય.
questions.qe: He is blind ___ one eye.
questions.ee: For a defect of a body part we say 'blind in one eye', 'lame in one leg'.

questions.q: He insisted ___ going there alone.
questions.e: 'insist' સાથે 'on' વપરાય અને પછી ક્રિયાપદનું -ing રૂપ આવે.
questions.qe: He insisted ___ going there alone.
questions.ee: 'Insist' takes 'on', followed by the -ing form of the verb.

questions.q: Beware ___ pickpockets.
questions.e: 'beware' સાથે 'of' વપરાય: 'Beware of dogs'.
questions.qe: Beware ___ pickpockets.
questions.ee: 'Beware' takes 'of': 'Beware of dogs'.

questions.q: He was absent ___ the meeting.
questions.e: 'absent' સાથે 'from' વપરાય: 'absent from school'.
questions.qe: He was absent ___ the meeting.
questions.ee: 'Absent' takes 'from': 'absent from school'.

questions.q: My mother is suffering ___ fever.
questions.e: બીમારી માટે 'suffer from' વપરાય.
questions.qe: My mother is suffering ___ fever.
questions.ee: For an illness we say 'suffer from'.

questions.q: Every citizen should abide ___ the law.
questions.e: 'abide by' એટલે નિયમ/કાયદાનું પાલન કરવું.
questions.qe: Every citizen should abide ___ the law.
questions.ee: 'Abide by' means to obey a rule or law.

questions.q: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.e: સનાતન સત્ય માટે Simple Present વપરાય; ત્રીજો પુરુષ એકવચન કર્તા હોવાથી 'rises'.
questions.qe: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.ee: Universal truths take the simple present; with a third-person singular subject it is 'rises'.

questions.q: Look! The baby ___.
questions.e: 'Look!' બતાવે છે કે ક્રિયા અત્યારે ચાલુ છે, તેથી Present Continuous.
questions.qe: Look! The baby ___.
questions.ee: 'Look!' shows the action is happening now, so present continuous.

questions.q: He ___ to Mumbai yesterday.
questions.e: 'yesterday' જેવો ભૂતકાળનો ચોક્કસ સમય હોય તો Simple Past વપરાય; Present Perfect નહીં.
questions.qe: He ___ to Mumbai yesterday.
questions.ee: A definite past time like 'yesterday' takes the simple past, not the present perfect.

questions.q: She ___ a letter when I entered the room.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળમાં એક ક્રિયા ચાલુ હતી ત્યારે બીજી ક્રિયા બની, તેથી ચાલુ ક્રિયા માટે Past Continuous.
questions.qe: She ___ a letter when I entered the room.
questions.ee: One action was going on in the past when another happened, so the ongoing one takes the past continuous.

questions.q: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળની બે ક્રિયામાંથી પહેલાં પૂરી થયેલી ક્રિયા માટે Past Perfect (had + V3) વપરાય.
questions.qe: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
questions.ee: Of two past actions, the one finished first takes the past perfect (had + V3).

questions.q: I ___ him for ten years.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળથી અત્યાર સુધી ચાલુ સ્થિતિ માટે 'for' સાથે Present Perfect; 'know' Continuous રૂપમાં વપરાતું નથી.
questions.qe: I ___ him for ten years.
questions.ee: A state from the past till now with 'for' takes the present perfect; 'know' is not used in continuous forms.

questions.q: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.e: 'If' + Simple Present હોય તો મુખ્ય વાક્યમાં 'will' + V1 (First conditional) આવે.
questions.qe: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.ee: 'If' + simple present is followed by 'will' + V1 in the main clause (first conditional).

questions.q: Ravi ___ English well.
questions.e: ત્રીજો પુરુષ એકવચન કર્તા (Ravi) સાથે Simple Presentમાં ક્રિયાપદને -s/-es લાગે.
questions.qe: Ravi ___ English well.
questions.ee: With a third-person singular subject (Ravi) the simple present verb takes -s/-es.

questions.q: I ___ my lunch, so I am not hungry.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળમાં પૂરી થયેલી ક્રિયાનું પરિણામ અત્યારે દેખાય ત્યારે Present Perfect વપરાય.
questions.qe: I ___ my lunch, so I am not hungry.
questions.ee: When a finished past action has a result now, use the present perfect.

questions.q: The children ___ in the park every evening.
questions.e: રોજની ટેવ માટે Simple Present; બહુવચન કર્તા (children) સાથે ક્રિયાપદનું મૂળ રૂપ 'play' આવે.
questions.qe: The children ___ in the park every evening.
questions.ee: Daily habits take the simple present; a plural subject (children) takes the base form 'play'.

questions.q: She ___ for two hours when I reached her house.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળની બીજી ક્રિયા પહેલાં લાંબો સમય ચાલુ રહેલી ક્રિયા માટે Past Perfect Continuous વપરાય.
questions.qe: She ___ for two hours when I reached her house.
questions.ee: An action that went on for a long time before another past action takes the past perfect continuous.

questions.q: If you had worked hard, you ___ passed.
questions.e: 'If' + had + V3 (Third conditional) સાથે મુખ્ય વાક્યમાં 'would have + V3' આવે.
questions.qe: If you had worked hard, you ___ passed.
questions.ee: 'If' + had + V3 (third conditional) is followed by 'would have + V3'.

questions.q: By next March, he ___ in this office for five years.
questions.e: ભવિષ્યના ચોક્કસ સમય સુધીમાં પૂરી થનારી ક્રિયા માટે Future Perfect (will have + V3) વપરાય.
questions.qe: By next March, he ___ in this office for five years.
questions.ee: An action to be completed by a definite future time takes the future perfect (will have + V3).

questions.q: It is high time we ___ home.
questions.e: 'It is high time' પછી Simple Past વપરાય, ભલે અર્થ વર્તમાનનો હોય.
questions.qe: It is high time we ___ home.
questions.ee: 'It is high time' is followed by the simple past, even though the meaning is present.

questions.q: No sooner had he reached the station than the train ___.
questions.e: 'No sooner had ... than' રચનામાં 'than' પછી Simple Past આવે.
questions.qe: No sooner had he reached the station than the train ___.
questions.ee: In 'No sooner had ... than', the simple past follows 'than'.

questions.q: I wish I ___ the answer now.
questions.e: વર્તમાનની અધૂરી ઇચ્છા બતાવવા 'I wish' પછી Simple Past વપરાય.
questions.qe: I wish I ___ the answer now.
questions.ee: An unfulfilled wish about the present uses the simple past after 'I wish'.

questions.q: This time tomorrow, I ___ to Delhi.
questions.e: ભવિષ્યના ચોક્કસ સમયે ચાલુ હશે તેવી ક્રિયા માટે Future Continuous (will be + V-ing) વપરાય.
questions.qe: This time tomorrow, I ___ to Delhi.
questions.ee: An action that will be going on at a definite future time takes the future continuous (will be + V-ing).

questions.q: He ___ ill since last week.
questions.e: 'since' સાથે ભૂતકાળથી અત્યાર સુધી ચાલુ સ્થિતિ બતાવવા Present Perfect 'has been' વપરાય.
questions.qe: He ___ ill since last week.
questions.ee: A state from the past till now with 'since' takes the present perfect 'has been'.

questions.q: Unless you ___ hard, you will fail.
questions.e: 'Unless' (= if not) પછી Simple Present આવે; તેમાં ફરી 'not' મુકાતું નથી.
questions.qe: Unless you ___ hard, you will fail.
questions.ee: 'Unless' (= if not) is followed by the simple present, without another 'not'.

questions.q: Two years ___ since he left the village.
questions.e: 'since' વાળા વાક્યમાં મુખ્ય ક્રિયાપદ Present Perfect હોય; 'Two years' બહુવચન હોવાથી 'have passed'.
questions.qe: Two years ___ since he left the village.
questions.ee: In a sentence with 'since' the main verb is present perfect; 'two years' is plural, so 'have passed'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Ram writes a letter.
o: A letter was written by Ram.
A letter is written by Ram.
A letter is being written by Ram.
A letter has been written by Ram.
questions.e: Simple Presentનું કર્મણિ 'is/am/are + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Ram writes a letter.
oe: A letter was written by Ram.
A letter is written by Ram.
A letter is being written by Ram.
A letter has been written by Ram.
questions.ee: The passive of the simple present is 'is/am/are + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: She is cooking food.
o: Food was being cooked by her.
Food has been cooked by her.
Food is being cooked by her.
questions.e: Present Continuousનું કર્મણિ 'is/are being + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: She is cooking food.
oe: Food was being cooked by her.
Food has been cooked by her.
Food is being cooked by her.
questions.ee: The passive of the present continuous is 'is/are being + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: They have completed the work.
o: The work has been completed by them.
The work was completed by them.
The work had been completed by them.
The work is completed by them.
questions.e: Present Perfectનું કર્મણિ 'has/have been + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: They have completed the work.
oe: The work has been completed by them.
The work was completed by them.
The work had been completed by them.
The work is completed by them.
questions.ee: The passive of the present perfect is 'has/have been + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: The police arrested the thief.
o: The thief is arrested by the police.
The thief has been arrested by the police.
The thief was arrested by the police.
The thief had been arrested by the police.
questions.e: Simple Pastનું કર્મણિ 'was/were + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: The police arrested the thief.
oe: The thief is arrested by the police.
The thief has been arrested by the police.
The thief was arrested by the police.
The thief had been arrested by the police.
questions.ee: The passive of the simple past is 'was/were + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Who wrote this book?
o: By whom is this book written?
By whom was this book written?
Whom this book was written by?
questions.e: 'Who'થી શરૂ થતા પ્રશ્નના કર્મણિમાં 'By whom' વપરાય અને કાળ (Simple Past) એ જ રહે.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Who wrote this book?
oe: By whom is this book written?
By whom was this book written?
Whom this book was written by?
questions.ee: A question starting with 'Who' becomes 'By whom' in the passive, keeping the tense (simple past).

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Close the door.
questions.e: આજ્ઞાર્થ વાક્યનું કર્મણિ 'Let + કર્મ + be + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Close the door.
questions.ee: The passive of a command is 'Let + object + be + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: He will help you.
o: You would be helped by him.
You will be helped by him.
questions.e: Simple Futureનું કર્મણિ 'will/shall be + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: He will help you.
oe: You would be helped by him.
You will be helped by him.
questions.ee: The passive of the simple future is 'will/shall be + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: I was reading a novel.
o: A novel was read by me.
A novel was being read by me.
A novel is being read by me.
A novel had been read by me.
questions.e: Past Continuousનું કર્મણિ 'was/were being + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: I was reading a novel.
oe: A novel was read by me.
A novel was being read by me.
A novel is being read by me.
A novel had been read by me.
questions.ee: The passive of the past continuous is 'was/were being + V3'.

questions.q: Choose the active voice: The song was sung by Lata.
questions.e: 'was sung' Simple Pastનું કર્મણિ છે, તેથી કર્તરિમાં Simple Past 'sang' આવે.
questions.qe: Choose the active voice: The song was sung by Lata.
questions.ee: 'Was sung' is the simple past passive, so the active uses the simple past 'sang'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: We must obey the laws.
o: The laws must obey by us.
The laws must be obeyed by us.
The laws must have obeyed us.
The laws are obeyed by us.
questions.e: Modal (must, can, should) વાળા વાક્યનું કર્મણિ 'modal + be + V3' થી બને.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: We must obey the laws.
oe: The laws must obey by us.
The laws must be obeyed by us.
The laws must have obeyed us.
The laws are obeyed by us.
questions.ee: A sentence with a modal (must, can, should) becomes 'modal + be + V3' in the passive.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: They are building a new bridge.
o: A new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge has been built by them.
A new bridge was being built by them.
questions.e: Present continuous નું passive: is/are being + V3.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: They are building a new bridge.
oe: A new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge has been built by them.
A new bridge was being built by them.
questions.ee: Present continuous passive: is/are being + V3.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: She had written the report.
o: The report had written by her.
The report had been written by her.
The report has been written by her.
The report was written by her.
questions.e: Past perfect નું passive: had been + V3.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: She had written the report.
oe: The report had written by her.
The report had been written by her.
The report has been written by her.
The report was written by her.
questions.ee: Past perfect passive: had been + V3.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: People speak English all over the world.
o: English is being spoken all over the world.
English has spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
questions.e: Simple present નું passive: is/am/are + V3; 'people' જેવો સામાન્ય કર્તા છોડી દેવાય છે.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: People speak English all over the world.
oe: English is being spoken all over the world.
English has spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
questions.ee: Simple present passive: is/am/are + V3; a general subject like 'people' is dropped.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Did he invite you?
o: Have you been invited by him?
questions.e: Did પ્રશ્નનું passive: Was/Were + subject + V3; 'you' સાથે were આવે.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Did he invite you?
oe: Have you been invited by him?
questions.ee: A 'Did' question becomes Was/Were + subject + V3; 'you' takes 'were'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Please give me a pen.
o: You are requested to give me a pen.
A pen was given to me.
A pen has been given by me.
questions.e: વિનંતી (Please) વાળા આજ્ઞાર્થનું passive: You are requested to …
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Please give me a pen.
oe: You are requested to give me a pen.
A pen was given to me.
A pen has been given by me.
questions.ee: A polite command (Please) becomes 'You are requested to …'.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: The cat killed the rat.
o: The cat was killed by the rat.
The rat was killed by the cat.
The rat had been killed by the cat.
The rat is killed by the cat.
questions.e: Simple past નું passive: was/were + V3; કર્તા અને કર્મ અદલાબદલ થાય, અર્થ નહીં.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: The cat killed the rat.
oe: The cat was killed by the rat.
The rat was killed by the cat.
The rat had been killed by the cat.
The rat is killed by the cat.
questions.ee: Simple past passive: was/were + V3; subject and object swap, the meaning does not change.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Someone has stolen my bag.
questions.e: Present perfect નું passive: has/have been + V3; 'someone' જેવો અજાણ્યો કર્તા લખાતો નથી.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Someone has stolen my bag.
questions.ee: Present perfect passive: has/have been + V3; an unknown doer like 'someone' is left out.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: The manager will sign the letters.
o: The letters will have been signed by the manager.
The letters would be signed by the manager.
The letters will signed by the manager.
The letters will be signed by the manager.
questions.e: Simple future નું passive: will be + V3.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: The manager will sign the letters.
oe: The letters will have been signed by the manager.
The letters would be signed by the manager.
The letters will signed by the manager.
The letters will be signed by the manager.
questions.ee: Simple future passive: will be + V3.

questions.q: Choose the active voice: The match was won by India.
questions.e: was won (simple past passive) નું active: India won (simple past).
questions.qe: Choose the active voice: The match was won by India.
questions.ee: 'Was won' (simple past passive) becomes 'India won' (simple past) in the active.

questions.q: Choose the passive voice: Do not touch the wire.
o: Let the wire not be touched.
Do not let the wire touched.
questions.e: નિષેધ આજ્ઞાર્થનું passive: Let + object + not be + V3.
questions.qe: Choose the passive voice: Do not touch the wire.
oe: Let the wire not be touched.
Do not let the wire touched.
questions.ee: A negative command becomes 'Let + object + not be + V3'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I am ill."
o: He said that I was ill.
He said that he is ill.
He said that he was ill.
He said that he had been ill.
questions.e: Reporting verb ભૂતકાળમાં હોય તો Simple Present બદલાઈને Simple Past થાય ('am' → 'was') અને 'I' → 'he'.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I am ill."
oe: He said that I was ill.
He said that he is ill.
He said that he was ill.
He said that he had been ill.
questions.ee: With a past reporting verb the simple present becomes simple past ('am' → 'was') and 'I' → 'he'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said to me, "I like you."
o: She told me that she liked me.
She said me that she liked me.
She told me that I liked you.
She told to me that she likes me.
questions.e: 'said to' + કર્મ હોય તો indirectમાં 'told' વપરાય; 'like' → 'liked' થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: She said to me, "I like you."
oe: She told me that she liked me.
She said me that she liked me.
She told me that I liked you.
She told to me that she likes me.
questions.ee: 'Said to' + object becomes 'told'; 'like' becomes 'liked'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: The teacher said, "The earth is round."
o: The teacher said that the earth was round.
The teacher said that the earth had been round.
The teacher told that the earth is round.
The teacher said that the earth is round.
questions.e: સનાતન સત્ય (universal truth)નો કાળ indirect speechમાં બદલાતો નથી.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: The teacher said, "The earth is round."
oe: The teacher said that the earth was round.
The teacher said that the earth had been round.
The teacher told that the earth is round.
The teacher said that the earth is round.
questions.ee: The tense of a universal truth does not change in indirect speech.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: Ram said, "I will go tomorrow."
o: Ram said that he will go tomorrow.
Ram said that he would go the next day.
Ram said that I would go tomorrow.
Ram said that he would go yesterday.
questions.e: 'will' → 'would' અને 'tomorrow' → 'the next day' (કે 'the following day') થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: Ram said, "I will go tomorrow."
oe: Ram said that he will go tomorrow.
Ram said that he would go the next day.
Ram said that I would go tomorrow.
Ram said that he would go yesterday.
questions.ee: 'Will' → 'would' and 'tomorrow' → 'the next day' (or 'the following day').

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said to him, "Where do you live?"
o: She asked him where did he live.
She said him where he lived.
She asked him where do you live.
She asked him where he lived.
questions.e: પ્રશ્નાર્થ વાક્યમાં 'asked' વપરાય અને indirectમાં વાક્યરચના વિધાન જેવી (કર્તા પછી ક્રિયાપદ) થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: She said to him, "Where do you live?"
oe: She asked him where did he live.
She said him where he lived.
She asked him where do you live.
She asked him where he lived.
questions.ee: Questions use 'asked', and in indirect speech the word order becomes a statement (subject before verb).

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: The teacher said to us, "Sit down."
o: The teacher said us to sit down.
The teacher ordered us that sit down.
The teacher ordered us to sit down.
The teacher ordered that we sat down.
questions.e: આજ્ઞાર્થ વાક્યમાં 'ordered/told' + કર્મ + 'to' + V1 વપરાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: The teacher said to us, "Sit down."
oe: The teacher said us to sit down.
The teacher ordered us that sit down.
The teacher ordered us to sit down.
The teacher ordered that we sat down.
questions.ee: Commands use 'ordered/told' + object + 'to' + V1.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Are you coming?"
o: He asked me if was I coming.
He asked me if I was coming.
He asked me that I was coming.
He told me if I am coming.
questions.e: Yes/No પ્રશ્નમાં 'if/whether' વડે જોડાય અને 'are coming' → 'was coming' થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Are you coming?"
oe: He asked me if was I coming.
He asked me if I was coming.
He asked me that I was coming.
He told me if I am coming.
questions.ee: Yes/no questions are joined with 'if/whether' and 'are coming' → 'was coming'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I have finished my work."
o: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that he has finished his work.
He said that I had finished my work.
He said that he finished my work.
questions.e: Present Perfect બદલાઈને Past Perfect થાય ('have finished' → 'had finished').
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I have finished my work."
oe: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that he has finished his work.
He said that I had finished my work.
He said that he finished my work.
questions.ee: The present perfect becomes past perfect ('have finished' → 'had finished').

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Please help me."
o: He requested me to help me.
He ordered me that help him.
He requested me to help him.
He requested me that I help me.
questions.e: 'Please' વાળા વાક્યમાં 'requested' + કર્મ + 'to' + V1 વપરાય અને 'please' શબ્દ નીકળી જાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Please help me."
oe: He requested me to help me.
He ordered me that help him.
He requested me to help him.
He requested me that I help me.
questions.ee: With 'please', use 'requested' + object + 'to' + V1 and drop the word 'please'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He says, "I am busy."
o: He says that he was busy.
He said that he was busy.
He says that I am busy.
He says that he is busy.
questions.e: Reporting verb વર્તમાનકાળ (says) માં હોય તો અંદરના વાક્યનો કાળ બદલાતો નથી.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He says, "I am busy."
oe: He says that he was busy.
He said that he was busy.
He says that I am busy.
He says that he is busy.
questions.ee: When the reporting verb is present (says), the tense inside does not change.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I am writing a letter."
o: He said that I was writing a letter.
He said that he was writing a letter.
He said that he is writing a letter.
He said that he had been write a letter.
questions.e: Reporting verb ભૂતકાળમાં હોય તો am writing → was writing થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I am writing a letter."
oe: He said that I was writing a letter.
He said that he was writing a letter.
He said that he is writing a letter.
He said that he had been write a letter.
questions.ee: With a past reporting verb, 'am writing' → 'was writing'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said, "I saw a snake."
o: She said that she had seen a snake.
She said that she has seen a snake.
She said that I had seen a snake.
She said that she sees a snake.
questions.e: Simple past (saw) નું indirect માં past perfect (had seen) થાય છે.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: She said, "I saw a snake."
oe: She said that she had seen a snake.
She said that she has seen a snake.
She said that I had seen a snake.
She said that she sees a snake.
questions.ee: The simple past (saw) becomes past perfect (had seen) in indirect speech.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "What is your name?"
o: He asked me what is my name.
He asked me what was my name.
He asked me what my name was.
He told me what my name was.
questions.e: Wh- પ્રશ્નમાં said to → asked અને વાક્ય સાદા ક્રમમાં: what my name was.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "What is your name?"
oe: He asked me what is my name.
He asked me what was my name.
He asked me what my name was.
He told me what my name was.
questions.ee: In a Wh- question, 'said to' → 'asked' and the clause takes statement order: what my name was.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: Mother said, "Don't make a noise."
o: Mother asked us that we don't make a noise.
Mother said that don't make a noise.
Mother told us to not making a noise.
Mother told us not to make a noise.
questions.e: નિષેધ આજ્ઞાર્થ: told/ordered + not to + V1.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: Mother said, "Don't make a noise."
oe: Mother asked us that we don't make a noise.
Mother said that don't make a noise.
Mother told us to not making a noise.
Mother told us not to make a noise.
questions.ee: A negative command: told/ordered + not to + V1.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I can swim."
o: He said that I could swim.
He said that he could swim.
He said that he can swam.
He said that he could swam.
questions.e: can → could; could પછી મૂળ રૂપ (swim) આવે.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I can swim."
oe: He said that I could swim.
He said that he could swim.
He said that he can swam.
He said that he could swam.
questions.ee: 'Can' → 'could', followed by the base form (swim).

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: She said, "I may come today."
o: She said that she may come today.
She said that she must come that day.
She said that she might come today.
She said that she might come that day.
questions.e: may → might અને today → that day થાય.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: She said, "I may come today."
oe: She said that she may come today.
She said that she must come that day.
She said that she might come today.
She said that she might come that day.
questions.ee: 'May' → 'might' and 'today' → 'that day'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Did you see the film?"
o: He asked me if I had seen the film.
He told me if I had seen the film.
He asked me did I see the film.
He asked me if I saw the film.
questions.e: Did વાળો પ્રશ્ન → asked + if/whether + past perfect.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said to me, "Did you see the film?"
oe: He asked me if I had seen the film.
He told me if I had seen the film.
He asked me did I see the film.
He asked me if I saw the film.
questions.ee: A 'Did' question → asked + if/whether + past perfect.

questions.q: Choose the direct speech: They said that they were tired.
questions.e: Indirect માં were (ભૂતકાળ) છે, એટલે direct માં are અને they → we થાય.
questions.qe: Choose the direct speech: They said that they were tired.
questions.ee: The indirect form has 'were' (past), so the direct form has 'are', and 'they' → 'we'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: The boy said, "Hurrah! I have won the match."
o: The boy exclaimed with sorrow that he had won the match.
The boy exclaimed with joy that I had won the match.
The boy said hurrah that he has won the match.
The boy exclaimed with joy that he had won the match.
questions.e: ઉદ્ગારવાચક વાક્યમાં Hurrah → exclaimed with joy; have won → had won.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: The boy said, "Hurrah! I have won the match."
oe: The boy exclaimed with sorrow that he had won the match.
The boy exclaimed with joy that I had won the match.
The boy said hurrah that he has won the match.
The boy exclaimed with joy that he had won the match.
questions.ee: In an exclamation, 'Hurrah' → 'exclaimed with joy'; 'have won' → 'had won'.

questions.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "Let us go out."
o: He proposed that they should go out.
He said that they will go out.
He told that let us go out.
He ordered them to go out.
questions.e: 'Let us' વાળા સૂચનમાં proposed/suggested that … should વપરાય છે.
questions.qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, "Let us go out."
oe: He proposed that they should go out.
He said that they will go out.
He told that let us go out.
He ordered them to go out.
questions.ee: A suggestion with 'Let us' uses 'proposed/suggested that … should'.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Abandon'.
questions.e: 'Abandon' એટલે ત્યજી દેવું; 'Forsake'નો અર્થ પણ ત્યજવું થાય.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Abandon'.
questions.ee: 'Abandon' means to leave for good; 'forsake' means the same.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Brave'.
questions.e: 'Brave' એટલે બહાદુર; 'Courageous' તેનો સમાનાર્થી છે, જ્યારે 'Timid' (ડરપોક) વિરોધી છે.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Brave'.
questions.ee: 'Brave' means fearless; 'courageous' is a synonym and 'timid' an antonym.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Candid'.
questions.e: 'Candid' એટલે નિખાલસ, સ્પષ્ટ બોલનાર; 'Frank'નો પણ એ જ અર્થ છે.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Candid'.
questions.ee: 'Candid' means open and outspoken; 'frank' means the same.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Diligent'.
questions.e: 'Diligent' એટલે ખંતીલું, મહેનતુ; વિરોધી શબ્દ 'Lazy'.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Diligent'.
questions.ee: 'Diligent' means hard-working; the opposite is 'lazy'.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Eminent'.
questions.e: 'Eminent' એટલે પ્રતિષ્ઠિત, નામાંકિત; 'Distinguished'નો પણ એ જ અર્થ છે.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Eminent'.
questions.ee: 'Eminent' means famous and respected; 'distinguished' means the same.

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Gigantic'.
questions.e: 'Gigantic' એટલે વિશાળ, પ્રચંડ; 'Huge' તેનો સમાનાર્થી છે.
questions.qe: Choose the synonym of 'Gigantic'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Permanent'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Ascend'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Barren'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Exterior'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Maximum'.
questions.ee: Maximum = the most; the opposite is minimum.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Guilty'.
questions.ee: Guilty = having done wrong; the opposite is innocent.

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Import'.

questions.qe: Choose the antonym of 'Import'.

questions.q: One who cannot read or write is called ___.
questions.e: લખી-વાંચી ન શકે તે 'illiterate' (નિરક્ષર); 'illegible' એટલે ન વાંચી શકાય તેવું (લખાણ).
questions.qe: One who cannot read or write is called ___.
questions.ee: Someone who cannot read or write is 'illiterate'; 'illegible' describes writing that can't be read.

questions.q: A person who does not believe in God is called ___.
questions.e: ઈશ્વરમાં ન માને તે 'atheist' (નાસ્તિક); માને તે 'theist' (આસ્તિક).
questions.qe: A person who does not believe in God is called ___.
questions.ee: Someone who does not believe in God is an 'atheist'; a believer is a 'theist'.

questions.q: A doctor who treats children is called ___.
questions.e: બાળકોના ડૉક્ટર 'paediatrician'; ચામડીના રોગના ડૉક્ટર 'dermatologist'.
questions.qe: A doctor who treats children is called ___.
questions.ee: A children's doctor is a 'paediatrician'; a skin doctor is a 'dermatologist'.

questions.q: The life history of a person written by himself is called ___.
questions.e: પોતે લખેલું જીવનચરિત્ર 'autobiography' (આત્મકથા); બીજાએ લખેલું હોય તો 'biography'.
questions.qe: The life history of a person written by himself is called ___.
questions.ee: A life story written by oneself is an 'autobiography'; written by someone else, a 'biography'.

questions.q: A person who does not eat meat is called ___.
questions.e: માંસ ન ખાનાર 'vegetarian' (શાકાહારી); માણસનું માંસ ખાનાર 'cannibal'.
questions.qe: A person who does not eat meat is called ___.
questions.ee: Someone who does not eat meat is a 'vegetarian'; one who eats human flesh is a 'cannibal'.

questions.q: That which cannot be seen is called ___.
questions.e: જોઈ ન શકાય તે 'invisible'; જીતી ન શકાય તે 'invincible'.
questions.qe: That which cannot be seen is called ___.
questions.ee: What can't be seen is 'invisible'; what can't be defeated is 'invincible'.

questions.q: A place where birds are kept is called ___.
questions.e: પક્ષીઓ રાખવાની જગ્યા 'aviary'; મધમાખી ઉછેરની જગ્યા 'apiary'.
questions.qe: A place where birds are kept is called ___.
questions.ee: A place for keeping birds is an 'aviary'; a place for keeping bees is an 'apiary'.

questions.q: One who knows everything is called ___.
questions.e: સર્વજ્ઞ 'omniscient'; સર્વશક્તિમાન 'omnipotent' અને સર્વવ્યાપી 'omnipresent'.
questions.qe: One who knows everything is called ___.
questions.ee: All-knowing is 'omniscient'; all-powerful 'omnipotent' and everywhere 'omnipresent'.

questions.q: Government by the people is called ___.
questions.e: લોકો દ્વારા ચાલતું શાસન 'democracy' (લોકશાહી); રાજાનું શાસન 'monarchy'.
questions.qe: Government by the people is called ___.
questions.ee: Government by the people is 'democracy'; rule by a king is 'monarchy'.

questions.q: A speech made without preparation is called ___.
questions.e: પૂર્વતૈયારી વગર બોલાયેલું ભાષણ 'extempore' (તાત્કાલિક); 'verbatim' એટલે શબ્દશઃ.
questions.qe: A speech made without preparation is called ___.
questions.ee: A speech made without preparation is 'extempore'; 'verbatim' means word for word.

questions.q: A person who can speak two languages is called ___.

questions.qe: A person who can speak two languages is called ___.
questions.ee: Bilingual = knowing two languages; someone who knows many is a polyglot.

questions.q: A remedy for all diseases is called ___.

questions.qe: A remedy for all diseases is called ___.
questions.ee: Panacea = a cure for all diseases; an antidote cures a poison.

questions.q: A person who travels on foot is called ___.
questions.e: Pedestrian = રાહદારી.
questions.qe: A person who travels on foot is called ___.
questions.ee: Pedestrian = a person walking on the road.

questions.q: Animals that eat both plants and flesh are called ___.

questions.qe: Animals that eat both plants and flesh are called ___.
questions.ee: Omnivorous = eating both; herbivorous = plant-eating, carnivorous = meat-eating.

questions.q: A home where orphans are looked after is called ___.

questions.qe: A home where orphans are looked after is called ___.
questions.ee: Orphanage = a home for orphans.

questions.q: A person who is new to a job or activity is called ___.

questions.qe: A person who is new to a job or activity is called ___.
questions.ee: Novice = a beginner; a veteran is very experienced.

questions.q: The scientific study of birds is called ___.

questions.qe: The scientific study of birds is called ___.
